'''Mace''' was a [[Sith Warrior]] who served as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]<ref name="Mace" /> to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tahm]]<ref name="Tahm">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Sith Lord Tahm|Balmorra}}</ref> of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]]. A bald and tan-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Mace made use of two [[orange]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat, and was proficient in casting violet [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] at his opponents. Mace,<ref name="Mace" /> his master,<ref name="Tahm" /> and his fellow apprentice [[Harp'r]]<ref name="Harp'r">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Apprentice Harp'r|Balmorra}}</ref> were [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] freedom<ref name="Mace" /> in [[3642 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mace appears as "Apprentice Mace" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Level 34 Elite enemy on the planet Balmorra, where he can be found along with Sith Lord Tahm and Apprentice Harp'r in the Sundari Flatlands region.<ref name="Mace" />
